g.text: Original-game snapshot | world coordinates | ground layer z=2
Conditional surfaces and routes. Doors, collision footprints and walking are not yet qualified.
The same x/y can describe different floors. The interactive HTML includes z=1..11 and a full-map view.
Green/brown: conditional flat support; dark: excluded or unresolved. Actor counts are not line-of-sight or alive-count proofs.
Teleports were checked in the original DOSBox world. Placement is not evidence that a route, staircase or gate can be crossed.
